tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground: cool morning lake (light), lake at night (dark). Never pure white or black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs on bg.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: segmented-control track, day strip, chips at rest, progress tracks.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: The one raised "next up" card per screen. Text on it is ink-on-deep.

tokens.name: ink-on-deep
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-deep and on scenes.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted layer over the scene band (blur 16px, saturate 1.3).

tokens.name: glass-scene
tokens.usage: Always-dark glass over full-bleed scenes (idle screen, focus on desktop). Same in both themes because scenes are photographic.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text. 15.5:1 on surface (light), 12.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta, hints, captions. 5.7:1 on surface light, 6.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Decorative and disabled only, icons at rest. Never body text (3.6:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Not a control boundary on its own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control (inputs, secondary buttons, checkbox rims): 3:1 against surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Cobalt. Primary actions, selection, links, focus ring. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected tab/rail item ground, hover wash.

tokens.name: accent-on-deep
tokens.usage: The primary action on surface-deep (the next-up card): cobalt lifted for 6.3:1 against the deep ground; text on it is surface-deep.

tokens.name: win
tokens.usage: Highlighter yellow. ONLY wins (done, today's habit kept) and the one must-remember mark in summaries. Never a button colour at rest.

tokens.name: win-ink
tokens.usage: Text on win. 11.5:1.

tokens.name: win-soft
tokens.usage: Notes and gentle banners (the kit's idea box ground).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Sage. Ready / on track. Text-safe on surface and bg.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Clay. Needs attention (overdue, below target). Deliberately not alarm red: calm, not urgent.

tokens.name: now
tokens.usage: The now-line on the timeline and live time marks only.

tokens.name: break
tokens.usage: Break phase in timers (on dark glass).

tokens.name: box-idea
tokens.usage: Kit box: analogy ('כמו').

tokens.name: box-idea-line
tokens.usage: Kit box border.

tokens.name: box-core
tokens.usage: Kit box: precise definition ('בדיוק').

tokens.name: box-core-line
tokens.usage: Kit box border.

tokens.name: box-ex
tokens.usage: Kit box: worked example.

tokens.name: box-ex-line
tokens.usage: Kit box border.

tokens.name: box-trap
tokens.usage: Kit box: common mistake.

tokens.name: box-trap-line
tokens.usage: Kit box border.

tokens.name: box-add
tokens.usage: Kit box: Claude's own explanation, not from the material.

tokens.name: box-add-line
tokens.usage: Kit box border.

tokens.name: course-1
tokens.usage: Course colour 1. For marks only: dots, stripes, progress fills, node rims (3:1+). Course names in text stay ink with a course dot.

tokens.name: scene-sky

tokens.name: scene-far
tokens.usage: Scene fallback far ridge.

tokens.name: scene-mid
tokens.usage: Scene fallback mid ridge.

tokens.name: scene-near

tokens.name: scene-accent
tokens.usage: Scene fallback sun/moon.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: Focus timer digits. Fluid clamp(64px, 22vw, 110px), tabular, LTR.

styles.name: greeting
styles.usage: Screen title / greeting. Fluid clamp(30px, 6vw, 44px). One per screen.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Next-up card title, sheet titles. clamp(22px, 5vw, 28px).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: כמה דקות של סיכום, ומחר מתחיל ברור יותר.
styles.usage: Running text. Dark theme uses weight 500 (Assistant thins on dark).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis in running text, button labels at 15px.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Smallest text allowed. Legends, timestamps, sources.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Tab and rail labels, tags. Never smaller.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner gap, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, phone side gutter (minimum).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections on phone.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap on desktop, column gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Screen-level separation.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room on large screens.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, sources, tiny badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, rows, sheets on phone.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The next-up card, desktop sheets, glass timer.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, pills, small action buttons inside cards.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: The next-up card, sheets, toast.

size.note: Fixed sizes for touch targets and shell parts.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable (Apple HIG 44pt; above WCAG 2.2 AA 24px).

tokens.name: target-lg
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and focus-flow choices.

tokens.name: tabbar
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height, plus safe-area-inset-bottom.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Navigation rail width from 600px.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Scene band height on phone; 216px from 1024px.

tokens.name: content
tokens.usage: Max content width (fullscreen 1920+ stays centred).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for running text.

breakpoint.note: Window classes adapted from Material 3; content-driven, not device names.

tokens.name: bp-medium
tokens.usage: Rail replaces bottom tabs; tablet portrait, half-window laptop, phone landscape.

tokens.name: bp-expanded
tokens.usage: Two-column Today, Gaps grid 2 cols.

tokens.name: bp-large
tokens.usage: Wider gutters, Gaps grid 3 cols, larger band.

duration.note: Motion is calm and predictable. prefers-reduced-motion: crossfades only, no drift.

tokens.name: dur-1
tokens.usage: Press feedback.

tokens.name: dur-2
tokens.usage: State change: toggles, chips, tabs.

tokens.name: dur-3
tokens.usage: Screen enter, sheet open.

tokens.name: dur-scene
tokens.usage: Scene crossfade; idle fade-in.

tokens.name: drift-cycle
tokens.usage: Scene camera glide cycle (70–100 s).

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that responds to the user.

tokens.name: ease-ambient
tokens.usage: Scene drift and breathing guide: symmetric, no snap.
